summary: Full-stack testing complete. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests pass (config, employees CRUD, 404 handling). Frontend: full Playwright E2E flow verified (KPIs load, scenario switching changes values in expected direction, sliders update KPIs in real-time, hires slider disabled in Restrictif, reset works, employee CRUD reflects in table and recalculates KPIs).
critical_code_review_comments: PUT/DELETE /api/employees/{id} raises 500 (uncaught bson.errors.InvalidId) when a non-ObjectId string is supplied; consider wrapping ObjectId(id) with try/except -> 404. Currently returns 500 for malformed IDs (not exercised by UI which always uses returned ids, so low impact).
POST /api/employees returns 200 instead of 201 (minor REST convention deviation).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 12 employees on startup when collection empty. Tests create/delete TEST_ prefixed employees (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend uses fr-CA currency with non-breaking spaces; parse digits only. Scenario tab testids use lowercased dashed names including accented chars (scenario-tab-scénario-croissance). Hires slider disabled state reflected via data-disabled attribute (Radix), not aria-disabled on inner role=slider.
